critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1037 lines — well past the 700-line split threshold. Split into routers/{auth,editoras,autores,uploads,reports,repasses,notifications}.py.

/api/notifications/send trusts request.headers['origin'] as frontend_origin fallback — an attacker-controlled Origin header could land in notification emails. Prefer FRONTEND_URL env only, or whitelist.

repasses upsert uses Mongo find_one on (scope, scope_id, competencia) but relies on unique index declared at startup — concurrent requests between find_one and insert could still race; use upsert=True with $setOnInsert for created_at.
Email guard _assert_safe_email runs at send time only — add a unit test around build_editora/autor_email_html output so content regressions are caught.

Bulk ZIP endpoint iterates ALL editoras/autores and generates PDFs sequentially inside the request — for large tenants this will block the event loop and exceed proxy timeouts. Consider streaming or a background job for >50 PDFs.
Still no brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (carryover from iter 1 playbook check).
